parrafo.es: The Blissful Baker diseña pasteles de cumpleaños, bodas, cupcakes, mesas de postres y pies a medida desde Port St. Lucie. Cada pedido se hornea y decora a mano según tu idea, foto o boceto, incluyendo opciones sin gluten y sin lácteos.
parrafo.en: The Blissful Baker designs custom birthday cakes, wedding cakes, cupcakes, dessert tables and pies out of Port St. Lucie. Every order is baked and hand decorated to match your idea, photo or sketch, with gluten-free and dairy-free options available.

hero.imagen_alt: Custom chocolate drip birthday cake topped with mini liquor bottle and candy by The Blissful Baker

parrafo_1.es: The Blissful Baker es una repostería de Port St. Lucie donde Mary hornea y decora cada pedido ella misma: pasteles de cumpleaños, bodas, baby showers y cupcakes, trabajando a partir de una foto, un boceto o incluso un diseño hecho en Canva.
parrafo_1.en: The Blissful Baker is a Port St. Lucie bakery where Mary bakes and decorates every order herself: birthday cakes, wedding cakes, baby showers and cupcakes, working from a photo, a sketch or even a design mocked up in Canva.

parrafo_2.es: Sus reseñas en Google destacan lo mismo una y otra vez: responde rápido, se adapta a alergias e intolerancias (sin gluten, sin lácteos) y el pastel final luce exactamente como se acordó.
parrafo_2.en: Her Google reviewers say the same thing again and again: she replies fast, accommodates allergies and intolerances (gluten-free, dairy-free), and the finished cake looks exactly like what was agreed.

texto.es: Cuéntanos la fecha, la ocasión y tu idea. Una foto, un boceto o un diseño en Canva ya es suficiente para empezar.
texto.en: Tell us the date, the occasion and your idea. A photo, a sketch or even a Canva design is enough to get started.

texto.es: Mary revisa el diseño, los sabores y cualquier alergia (sin gluten, sin lácteos disponible) y te da el precio antes de hornear nada.
texto.en: Mary reviews the design, the flavors and any allergies (gluten-free, dairy-free available) and quotes the job before anything gets baked.

texto.es: Cada pastel se hornea y decora siguiendo el diseño acordado, capa por capa y flor por flor.
texto.en: Every cake is baked and hand decorated following the agreed design, layer by layer and flower by flower.

texto.es: Recoges tu pedido listo para la celebración, exactamente como lo acordamos.
texto.en: You pick up your order ready for the celebration, exactly as agreed.

nota.es: Cada pastel se cotiza según su diseño, tamaño y sabores. Escríbenos o llama y Mary te da el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every cake is quoted on its own design, size and flavors. Message or call us and Mary will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Cumpleaños, aniversarios y ocasiones especiales, decorados a mano a partir de tu foto o idea, con opciones sin gluten y sin lácteos.
texto.en: Birthdays, anniversaries and milestone celebrations, hand decorated from your photo or idea, with gluten-free and dairy-free options.

subtitulo.es: Reseñas reales de clientes en Google.

items.quote: I ordered my daughter's 18th birthday cake from The Blissful Baker and I cannot recommend her enough! The cake was absolutely beautiful, turquoise, white, and gold cheetah print. It was the star of her yacht party, and it tasted just as amazing as it looked. Moist, flavorful, and everyone kept asking where it came from.

Mary is amazing! She's kind, responds super fast, and the best part, her cakes are so delicious! They're moist, sweet but not overly sweet, and the fillings are just the perfect proportion. She baked our wedding cake, which we received so many compliments on, and then our baby shower cake.

The cakes she made for our anniversary celebration were so beautiful and delicious, one was for friends who needed gluten-free and dairy-free. Mary was phenomenal to work with, she was so responsive, accommodating, creative, prompt...

texto.es: Llama o envía un mensaje de texto con tu fecha y tu idea.
texto.en: Call or send a text with your date and your idea.

texto.es: Lee las reseñas reales de clientes en Google antes de escribirnos.
texto.en: Read real customer reviews on Google before you reach out.

parrafo.es: Una llamada y empezamos: cuéntanos tu fecha y tu idea. Te respondemos con el detalle y el precio, sin compromiso.
parrafo.en: One call and we start: tell us your date and your idea. We will come back with the details and the price, no strings attached.
